name: Server-Side Request Forgery
absence_requirements: If the request URL is derived from user input, validate it against an allowlist of hosts and reject internal/link-local targets (169.254.169.254, 127.0.0.0/8, 10/8, 192.168/16) to prevent access to cloud metadata and internal services.
attack_scenario: attacker supplies a URL pointing at an internal service or the cloud metadata endpoint (169.254.169.254), and the server fetches it, leaking credentials or reaching services never meant to be exposed
negative_test_hint: submit url = "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/" and assert the request is refused

exemplar.compliant:
host = user_host.lower()
if host not in ALLOWED_HOSTS:
    abort(400)
url = "https://" + host + "/api"
r = requests.get(url, allow_redirects=False, timeout=5)
exemplar.explanation: validate the target against a host allowlist and block redirects before fetching a user-influenced URL
